reference.question: What are the countries where either English or Dutch is the official language ?
reference.gold_sql: SELECT t1.name FROM country AS t1 JOIN countrylanguage AS t2 ON t1.code = t2.countrycode WHERE t2.language = 'english' AND isofficial = 't' UNION SELECT t1.name FROM country AS t1 JOIN countrylanguage AS t2 ON t1.code = t2.countrycode WHERE t2.language = 'dutch' AND isofficial = 't'
